traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Casuarinaceae: leaves whorled; leaves simple; stipules absent; plants monoecious or dioecious; ovary superior; stems woody; flowers in catkins, in spikes or in heads; perianth absent; fruit nut or samara; stamens 1; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
